comment: The cartridges this builds from. Each is the same game; the translations moved its code, so the runtime's hooks into the USA code (config/addresses.json and config/patches.json) are found in the others by tools/map-versions.mjs. title: as sold, lettered on the launcher's case. region: the console the cartridge expects (us = overseas NTSC, eu = overseas PAL, jp = domestic NTSC; the Korean cartridge expects a domestic one too).
